scope: official StandardWalletAdapter + Umi + Core in LiteSVM; fake IndexedDB and faulted transport; no physical Phantom
checks: official signAndSend-only wallet creates a Core asset with owner, URI and 7% royalties
concurrent clicks coalesce to one wallet request
two controllers sharing atomic IndexedDB claim cannot both request mint
completed restart checks existing account with no new request or fee
wallet cancellation requires an explicit retry
lost successful wallet response recovers by saved asset without another mint
unknown wallet outcome blocks retry until finalized expiry and repeated absence
late wallet signature is saved after UI timeout
wrong wallet and wrong genesis cannot request a signature
account change during preparation stops before persisting or prompting
failed simulation and unavailable persistence prevent wallet prompts
on-chain failure is recorded as failed and never as an NFT success
an unfinalized chain error does not authorize a replacement
a lagging RPC cannot authorize expiry from a stale absent account
